pages.title: Cosmic Circuit Board
pages.text: A circuit board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold, its traces running through six compact dimensions. It holds circuits far larger than its surface, folded through hidden space. Turning it over, I can see the traces continue on the back, and into somewhere else.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tesseract Assembler, I wrapped a Metamaterial Substrate around a Calabi-Yau Manifold with a Cosmic String Segment, an Attoscale Inductor and Exotic Solder. The traces followed every dimension.
Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Processor, Ontological Processor, Transfinite Processor, Unified Notes II.
